thread:
li: FYI ran Mistral-2-small through AWQ int4 -> big quality drop on summarization and weird token artifacts at ~1k boundary.

sam: numbers?

li: fp16 rougeL 36.2 -> int4 rougeL 31.9. longctx ppl 12.4 -> 19.7.

li: repro: `redwood-quantize --model mistral-2-small --out m2s-int4 --scheme awq` then `redwood-bench --model m2s-int4 --task summarization --dataset summ-test-100 --max-tokens 2048`.

maria: tokenizer diffs?

li: diffed token ids vs fp16: ~8% samples show off-by-one around EOS; some examples have an extra sentinel token near 1024.

priya: did packing emit tokenizer files?

li: packing writes tokenizer_<commit>.json files. loader picks first tokenizer*.json found in bundle dir (nondet). stale tokenizer in bundle cache got picked, and special-token ids were swapped.

li: diff snippet: `- 28705: "</s>"` vs `+ 28705: "<pad>"`.

maria: that explains rouge + ppl collapse.

priya: quick fix?

li: added loader validation to check EOS/PAD/UNK ids against model.index.json and fail on mismatch. long-term: canonicalize to tokenizer.json and prefer explicit path in model metadata. also add pre-quant token-alignment gate (1k samples, fail if >0.5% special-token disagreement).

li: swapped canonical tokenizer into int4 bundle and re-ran: rougeL 35.9, ppl 12.8.

sam: open PR + unit test (tar with two tokenizers -> loader picks referenced one) + cache scrub migration script. tag me.

li: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/packaging/pull/432 (w/ failing test + fix). deploy-bot: CI queued.

maria: also add a short docs playbook for triaging EOS/PAD swaps and add checklist item to onboarding.

priya: will do.

li: TL;DR: int4 regression traced to nondeterministic tokenizer selection in bundle cache -> EOS/PAD id swap -> large long-ctx PPL and summarization drop. Fix = loader validation + canonical tokenizer naming + token-alignment gate + cache scrub.

sam: thanks li :thumbsup:
